name: Gemma B
bio:
Gemma B is a prestigious tattoo artist known for her exceptional talent in traditional and illustrative styles, honing her craft for over 16 years with an unwavering dedication to artistry. Operating out of Black Ink Rebellion in Newquay, Cornwall, she's earned the reputation of an electric wizard, weaving impressive designs with a high level of professionalism that is evident in both her stunning portfolio and the way she conducts her services. To experience her remarkable work, clients are encouraged to book via email or Facebook, as she maintains clear and accessible communication channels while keeping her focus on crafting incredible tattoos.
